name: feign
description: Feign makes writing java http clients easier

issues.title: Add support for streaming on requests (and add better handling for streaming in responses)
Add support for encoders even when no or multiple body parameters are present

latest_release.name: OpenFeign 13.18
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed * Add feign-jdk-json codec for the JDK Simple JSON API (JEP 540) and fix Dependabot auto-merge by @velo in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3620 * Exclude static fields from field query maps by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3613 * Treat runtime HeaderMap values as literals by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3612 * docs: fix typos in documentation by @hamidzr in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3659 * Reads response charset after other Content-Type parameters by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3628 * Read quoted and mixed-case charset parameters in FormEncoder by @kdelay in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3611 * Document that Logger reflects Feign's Request, not the wire request by @ChrisJr404 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3544 * Apply @Param expanders on QueryMap POJO fields and getters by @havefunatcode in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3658 * Add opt-in target host and port observation tags by @henriquejsza in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3546 * feign-kotlin: add non-blocking WebClient AsyncClient and improve coroutine support by @ggoowlgns in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3645 * skip private and Vary: * responses in HttpCacheInterceptor by @alhudz in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3610 * Enforce Java 11 response body timeouts by @goutamadwant in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3462 * feign-mock: allow matching request headers by subset by @lxcxjxhx in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3661 * Fix URI fragment replacement and preserve target escapes by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3633 * Honors reserved-character flag for unescaped URI values by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3627 * Preserve Java11 response header value order and duplicates by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3638 * Preserve literal query values and expand array parameters by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3624 * Recognize HTTP URI schemes without regard to case by @wozhenbang2004 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3665 * Honor zero connect and read timeouts in the Java11 client by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3637 * Restore Apache HTTP4 retries for bodyless idempotent requests by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3634 * Completes async client futures when the delegate throws Error by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3630 * Shares quote-aware charset parsing with form encoders by @hutiefang76 in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3674 * Reuse DefaultClient keep-alive connections when chunked bodies are not read to the end by @velo in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3673 ---
List of PRs that updated libraries versions
* build(deps): Bump com.google.testing.compile:compile-testing from 0.23.0 to 0.24.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3621 * build(deps-dev): Bump org.codehaus.mojo:versions-maven-plugin from 2.22.0 to 2.23.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3622 * build(deps-dev): Bump org.sonatype.central:central-publishing-maven-plugin from 0.11.0 to 0.12.0 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3632 * build(deps-dev): Bump com.github.siom79.japicmp:japicmp-maven-plugin from 0.26.3 to 0.26.5 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3639 * build(deps): Bump com.alibaba.fastjson2:fastjson2 from 2.0.65.android8 to 2.0.66.android8 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3640 * build(deps): Bump jackson.version from 2.22.3 to 2.22.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pull/3641 * build(deps): Bump com.fasterxml.jackson:jackson-bom from 2.22.3 to 2.22.4 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/OpenFeign/feign/pul
